userFacingDescription: The Show Blocked Trackers experiment was a win 🎉, so we are doing a broader phased rollout to desktop FF users.  This rollout is specific to just Nightly/BETA channels and will be a separate rollout for Release channel. Going forward, every time users goes to a first load of a site in a new tab/window/session, the shield icon will animate briefly to show how many trackers were blocked on the site to better showcase our anti-tracking protection. If users don't want to see the animation each time, they can toggle off the option "Show trackers blocked in address bar" in the Privacy Panel or in Settings without turning off ETP.
